newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Lend Lease buys 25 pct of THI Plc.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Lend Lease buys 25 pct of THI Plc.

text.p: Lend Lease Corp Ltd said on Friday that it had acquired a 25 percent stake in UK-based leisure property developer THI Plc as part of its strategy to become a leading retail and leisure developer in Britain.
The companies said in a statement that the arrangement, to cost Lend Lease three million pounds, would enable THI to access up to 25 million pounds of new working capital.
The statement said THI was responsible for over two million square feet of developments in over a dozen UK leisure parks.
The company was committed to a further one million square feet with a development programme in excess of 200 million pounds over the next three years, the statement said.
"There will be much synergy between THI, with its leisure skills, and Lend Lease, with its retail skills," THI chief executive Carl Lewis said.
Lend Lease acquired the stake previously held by Higgs and Hill Construction Ltd.
